Hello!

I was completely captivated by your use of color and visual effects. It was truly amazing.

My character is a magical sugar glider samurai who has mastered the art of drawing his sword, and his partner is an eel. Since he is a monster hunter, I would love it if you could depict the moment he draws his sword from the eel’s mouth to attack. As he is a sacred warrior, I think an effect where the sword is enveloped in yellow or silver light would be fitting for his divine character. Other than that, I leave everything to your professional judgment.

I have attached a design sheet for your reference.

Of course, I leave everything entirely up to you and your interpretation. Thank you very much for considering this project!
